statement.p: For each function below, consider its level surfaces, where w=\cdots -2,-1,0,1,2\cdots if negative w's are allowed, or w = 1,2,3,\cdots if negative w's are not allowed. Match each function with the verbal description of its level surfaces by placing the letter of the verbal description to the left of the number of the function.
